_note: Cross-repo binding for the motion roles. DECISIONS.md D-A10 is the rationale.
The kit and the platform host (My-Chat) carry the same five motion values under
DIFFERENT names: the host publishes `motion.duration_normal`, the kit publishes
`--t-base`. The cross-repo rule in DECISIONS.md keys on *same-named* roles, so a
differently-named pair is invisible to it — the two repos agreeing today is a
coincidence maintained by hand, not a guarantee. This file is the missing name
mapping, and `tokens/emit.mjs` turns it into a mechanical check that runs on every
`pnpm tokens` and `pnpm tokens:check` (and therefore on every `pnpm build`).
1. Each locked role's `kit_var` exists in the Motion section at exactly `kit_value`.
2. `kit_value` equals `upstream_value`, unless the role carries a `deviation` string.
3. Every var in the Motion section is either a locked role or listed in `kit_local`.
Rule 3 is the one that matters: a new motion token cannot be added without deciding
whether it is a shared cross-platform role or a kit invention. That decision is the
thing that used to be skippable.
